title: Small Wings Behind the Council Office
titleZh: 议会办公室后的小小翅膀
paras: 12 July, 7 p.m. I spent my [[day-off|day off]] watching insects in the [[yard|yard]] behind our village council office. The council wanted to cover this small piece of [[land|land]] with stones. Before making a decision, they asked people to record its wildlife. Inside, a [[printer|printer]] was making copies of our record sheet. Beside it were bright yellow posters for a [[comedy|comedy]] show in the village hall.

I put half a [[pear|pear]] on an old wooden table and sat quietly nearby. Mr Karim, a [[businessman|businessman]] with a shop across the road, came to help me count. At first, we saw only two flies. Then the evening light began to [[shine|shine]] on the wet fruit. A brown butterfly landed on it. I [[immediately|immediately]] wrote down the time. It stayed for eleven minutes, slowly opening and closing its wings.

By nine, we had counted six kinds of insects around the table and nearby flowers. Mr Karim was [[glad|glad]] that we had stayed so long. We left our sheet at the office. Three days later, the council agreed to keep the flowers and grass. On my next visit, a small sign stood beside the table: 'Please leave this corner for wildlife.'
zh: 7月12日，晚上7点。我利用休息日在村议会办公室后面的院子里观察昆虫。议会想把这小块地铺上石子。在作出决定前，他们请大家记录这里的野生生物。屋内，一台打印机正在打印我们的记录表。旁边放着鲜黄色的海报，宣传将在村礼堂上演的一场喜剧。
我把半个梨放在一张旧木桌上，安静地坐在附近。卡里姆先生是一位商人，在马路对面开了一家店，他过来帮我计数。起初，我们只看到了两只苍蝇。接着，傍晚的阳光开始照在湿润的果肉上。一只棕色蝴蝶落在了上面。我立刻记下时间。它停留了十一分钟，缓缓地张开又合上翅膀。
到九点时，我们在桌子和附近的花丛周围数到了六种昆虫。卡里姆先生很高兴我们待了这么久。我们把记录表留在了办公室。三天后，议会同意保留这些花草。下次去时，我看到桌旁立着一块小牌子，上面写着：“请把这个角落留给野生生物。”

q.s: The council asked people to record wildlife before it decided what to do with the land.
q.why: 议会作决定前请大家记录野生生物。

q.s: The brown butterfly had visited the yard before.
q.why: 文章未说明这只蝴蝶以前是否来过。

q.s: By nine, they had counted only two kinds of insects.
q.why: 到九点时，他们已数到六种昆虫。
